what: Provenance for the three scale-spike frames (100% / 150% / 200% of CameraView.GoblinDrawSize) captured by spikes/142-scale-spike/capture-scale-spike.ps1. The PNGs themselves are not committed — docs/engineering/EVIDENCE_WORKFLOW.md routes captures to .artifacts/ and AGENTS.md forbids large derived files in Git — so this file is the tracked record of how they were made.
parentCommitNote: Last commit before this file's own round-2 fix commit (findings 1-3 of the independent review: hidden 1.5x magnification, evidence/ committed against the .artifacts boundary, false 'headless' claim). The commit that adds this manifest is the authoritative source tree; re-running the command below against it reproduces byte-identical PNGs, which is how the review verified round 1's captures.
note: -GodotPath is a machine-local override for finding the executable and is not part of the reproducible command, same convention as capture-evidence.ps1 (see EVIDENCE_WORKFLOW.md, 'Явный -GodotPath используется только для поиска исполняемого файла').
worldMagnificationNote: Round 1 applied a hidden 1.5x scale to the whole world layer: the legend printed the logical numbers (tile 40px, body 36.4/54.5/72.7px at 100/150/200%) but the screen actually showed 1.5x that (tile 60px, body 54.5/81.8/109.1px) — exactly CameraView's 'Detail' zoom level, not the default zoom of 1.0. An owner judging the '100%' frame at face value would have picked a size one CameraView zoom step larger than the default camera renders. Fixed to 1.0: the frame is now WYSIWYG against the legend's own numbers.
